title: Separatedness descends to a finite stage of a limit
statement: Let $I$ be a directed set and $(S_i,f_{ii'})$ an inverse system of schemes [def-pc-scheme] over $I$ with affine transition morphisms [pqf-def-affine-morphism], with limit $S=\varprojlim_iS_i$ [lem-weil-pbc-limit-affine-transition]. Let $0\in I$ and let $f_0:X_0\to Y_0$ be a morphism of schemes over $S_0$, where $S_0$, $X_0$, $Y_0$ are quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. For $i\ge0$ let $f_i:X_i\to Y_i$ be the base change of $f_0$ to $S_i$ ($X_i=X_0\times_{S_0}S_i$, $Y_i=Y_0\times_{S_0}S_i$, fibre products [def-pc-fibre-product]) and $f:X\to Y$ its base change to $S$. If $f$ is separated [def-weil-proper-morphism], then there is $i\ge0$ such that $f_i$ is separated (Stacks Limits, Lemma 01ZQ; no finiteness hypothesis on $f_0$ is needed).

source.place: Lemma Tag 01ZQ (lemma-descend-separated-finite-presentation, line 1851) in Situation Tag 081D (situation-descent-property, line 1739); its proof applies Lemma Tag 01ZP (descend-closed-immersion-finite-presentation) to the diagonal $X_0\to X_0\times_{S_0}X_0$, using Schemes Lemma 01KJ (diagonal-immersion), Morphisms Lemma 01T5 (immersion-locally-finite-type) and Schemes Remark 0816 (quasi-compact-and-quasi-separated)

proof.text: The base-changed diagonal $\Delta_f:X\to X\times_Y X$ is a closed immersion because $f$ is separated. The diagonal $\Delta_{f_0}:X_0\to X_0\times_{Y_0}X_0$ is an immersion by [lem-weil-pbc-diagonal-immersion] (Stacks Schemes Lemma 01KJ), hence locally of finite type by [lem-weil-pbc-immersion-base-change-lft](2), which supplies exactly the locally-finite-type hypothesis of 01ZP. The source $X_0$ and target $X_0\times_{Y_0}X_0$ are quasi-compact and quasi-separated by [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-morphism-permanence]: clause (1) makes $f_0$ quasi-compact and quasi-separated from the qcqs hypotheses, clause (3) preserves these properties under the base change along $f_0$, and clause (2), with the qcqs target $X_0$, gives the qcqs fibre product.

proof.text: Use [lem-weil-pbc-over-pullback-diagonal-closed-immersion] at the limit to identify the base-changed stage diagonal as a closed immersion. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-descend-closed-immersion] to this diagonal, whose qcqs and locally-finite-type hypotheses are supplied by step 1. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-over-pullback-diagonal-closed-immersion] again at the resulting stage to obtain separatedness. This is the diagonal route of Tag 01ZQ, with the base-change identification proved explicitly in the new module.
